rationale: Two production precedents for write-tempfile-then-spawn-unlink-in-finally (host_runner.py:921-929, fsm/route_table.py:634-653); both fix sites already run a gh_tmp temp-resource try/finally. stdin/bash -s has zero confirming usage sites and adds a writer-vs-killpg hazard. Follow the NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) convention, not mkstemp.
rule: Option A: temp file — FSM shell actions spawn via bash on a script tempfile, not argv
alternatives_rejected: Option B: stdin (bash -s) with writer thread — no repo precedent, new concurrency failure mode
